finding.expected: Preserve PC5's ninth VOI consideration without creating a second deadline authority. P7.5 should reference/use the canonical P7.3 DecisionContext deadline and, if an inquiry needs caller-authored reasoning about deadline effects, represent that only as a clearly named bounded consideration/rationale rather than another deadline value. Remove acceptance of an independent inquiry datetime deadline, update documentation accordingly, and add a focused regression with a DecisionContext carrying a real deadline proving P7.5 cannot introduce a conflicting second deadline. Do not modify P7.3, P7.4, acquisition authority, roadmap ordering, or control-plane state.
finding.issue: P7.5 introduces an independently caller-supplied inquiry field named decision_deadline and even accepts a second datetime value, while published P7.3 DecisionContext is already the canonical owner of the decision deadline. The P7.5 factory validates context, hypothesis, and profile identity but never reconciles an inquiry deadline with DecisionContext.decision_deadline, so a single plan can contain two contradictory decision deadlines. This creates duplicate semantic ownership and violates the ONE_CAPABILITY_ONE_AUTHORITY boundary even though the P7.5 value is otherwise advisory.
